description: This file contains the definition of the pData class which is responsible for manipulating and managing data arrays for charting purposes, including data addition, series management, statistical calculations, and configuration of axes and series properties.

classes.name: pData
classes.description: Class to manipulate data arrays for charting, including series management, statistical calculations, and configuration options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the pData object with default properties and data structure.

methods.name: addPoints
methods.description: Adds a single value or array of values to a specified data series.

methods.name: stripVOID
methods.description: Removes VOID (null-equivalent) values from an array of data points.

methods.name: getSerieCount
methods.description: Returns the number of data points in a specified series.

methods.name: removeSerie
methods.description: Removes one or more series from the data object.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves a specific value from a series at a given index.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns all data points of a specified series.

methods.name: reverseSerie
methods.description: Reverses the order of data points in specified series.

methods.name: getSum
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of data points in a series.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum data point in a series.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum data point in a series.

methods.name: setSerieShape
methods.description: Sets the shape for a data series in the chart.

methods.name: setSerieDescription
methods.description: Sets a textual description for a data series.

methods.name: setSerieDrawable
methods.description: Marks a data series as drawable for rendering.

methods.name: setSeriePicture
methods.description: Associates a picture (icon) with a data series.

methods.name: setXAxisName
methods.description: Sets the label for the X Axis.

methods.name: setXAxisDisplay
methods.description: Configures how the X Axis is displayed, including format.

methods.name: setXAxisUnit
methods.description: Sets the unit label for the X Axis.

methods.name: setAbscissa
methods.description: Defines which series is used as the X axis values.

methods.name: setAbsicssaPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the abscissa axis.

methods.name: setAbscissaName
methods.description: Sets the label for the abscissa axis.

methods.name: setScatterSerie
methods.description: Creates a scatter plot series with X and Y data.

methods.name: setScatterSerieShape
methods.description: Sets the shape for points in a scatter series.

methods.name: setScatterSerieDescription
methods.description: Defines a description for a scatter series.

methods.name: setScatterSeriePicture
methods.description: Associates a picture with a scatter series.

methods.name: setScatterSerieDrawable
methods.description: Marks a scatter series as drawable for rendering.

methods.name: setScatterSerieTicks
methods.description: Defines tick width for scatter points.

methods.name: setScatterSerieWeight
methods.description: Sets the visual weight of scatter points.

methods.name: setScatterSerieColor
methods.description: Sets the color for a scatter series.

methods.name: limits
methods.description: Calculates and returns the global min and max values across drawable series.

methods.name: drawAll
methods.description: Marks all series as drawable.

methods.name: getSerieAverage
methods.description: Calculates the average value of a series.

methods.name: getGeometricMean
methods.description: Calculates the geometric mean of a series.

methods.name: getHarmonicMean
methods.description: Calculates the harmonic mean of a series.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of a series.

methods.name: getCoefficientOfVariation
methods.description: Calculates the coefficient of variation for a series.

methods.name: getSerieMedian
methods.description: Calculates the median value of a series.

methods.name: getSeriePercentile
methods.description: Calculates a specific percentile of a series.

methods.name: addRandomValues
methods.description: Adds random data points to a series based on options.

methods.name: containsData
methods.description: Checks if the data object contains any drawable data.

methods.name: setAxisDisplay
methods.description: Configures display mode and format for a given axis.

methods.name: setAxisPosition
methods.description: Sets the position for a specific axis.

methods.name: setAxisUnit
methods.description: Associates a unit label with an axis.

methods.name: setAxisName
methods.description: Sets the label for an axis.

methods.name: setAxisColor
methods.description: Sets the color for an axis.

methods.name: setAxisXY
methods.description: Designates whether an axis is X or Y.

methods.name: setSerieOnAxis
methods.description: Associates series with a specific axis.

methods.name: setSerieTicks
methods.description: Sets tick width for a series.

methods.name: setSerieWeight
methods.description: Sets visual weight for a series.

methods.name: getSeriePalette
methods.description: Retrieves the color palette associated with a series.

methods.name: setPalette
methods.description: Sets the color palette for series.

methods.name: loadPalette
methods.description: Loads a palette from a file.

methods.name: initScatterSerie
methods.description: Initializes a scatter series with default properties.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Initializes a new data series with default properties.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes data series based on a normalization factor.

methods.name: importFromCSV
methods.description: Imports data from a CSV file into series.

methods.name: createFunctionSerie
methods.description: Creates a data series based on a mathematical formula over a range.

methods.name: negateValues
methods.description: Negates data points in specified series.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the entire data and configuration object.

methods.name: savePalette
methods.description: Saves a color to the palette.

methods.name: getPalette
methods.description: Retrieves the current color palette.

methods.name: saveAxisConfig
methods.description: Saves axis configuration.

methods.name: saveYMargin
methods.description: Stores the Y margin value.

methods.name: saveExtendedData
methods.description: Stores extended data configuration.

methods.name: saveOrientation
methods.description: Stores orientation of the scale.

methods.name: convertToArray
methods.description: Converts a value into an array with one element.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Returns the leftmost characters of a string.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Returns the rightmost characters of a string.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns a substring starting at a position for a given length.
